# milsymbol 3.0.5 (vendored)

`milsymbol.js` is the built UMD bundle of [milsymbol](https://github.com/spatialillusions/milsymbol) by Måns Beckman
(Spatial Illusions), MIT license (`LICENSE` beside it). Downloaded 2026-11-09 from
`https://unpkg.com/milsymbol@3.0.5/dist/milsymbol.js`, unchanged.

Parchment's Military layer uses it for the **frame, glyph and size marks** of a force mark (MIL-STD-2525 / APP-6:
infantry, cavalry, artillery, armor, aviation, naval; X, XX, XXX…), drawn in the side's line color. History has no
"friend" or "hostile", so every side takes the same rectangular frame (the standard's friendly land frame) and the
standard's identity shapes are not used. The era is carried by a small equipment icon beside the frame
(`assets/icons/military/`), never by the frame.

Vendored rather than installed, so a lesson map renders from a fresh clone with no extra install step and the
desktop app's bundle keeps working offline.
